title: I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing
caption: I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing (V)
game_text: Plays on table. Unless Deep Hatred on table, opponent may use only one combat card per turn. While opponent has two Jedi on Naboo, you lose no more than 2 Force to Force drains at opponent’s Naboo sites. We’ll Handle This may target only droids and spies.
lore: Darth Vader ruthlessly used the Force to strike down enemies and soldiers who displeased him. He could choke victims from afar without touching them.
